I highly recommend Deerfield! I have taken my dog, Rudy, to Deerfield for his vet needs from the time I adopted him until we moved from San Antonio. We used to live right next to the clinic, then moved further away, but the commute was still worth it. Dr. Cantu provided exceptional care for his wellness exams and chronic issues with skin allergies. Dr. Provost was very accommodating in seeing us last-minute after my dog experienced more acute anal gland issues. The staff is also very welcoming!

My parents' dog was taken outside for a bathroom break and somehow either slipped or got loose from a collar and ran away. What was most concerning was the apparent lack of urgency in responding to the situation. Thankfully, a family member was able to locate the dog, but not before she sustained injuries, including an abrasion on her neck, raw paw pads, and a limp. After spending thousands of dollars here over the years, we expected a higher standard of care and proper procedures to be in place to prevent something like this from happening. Losing a dog while in y'all's care is unacceptable, and the injuries she suffered only add to our concern. We hope this incident is taken seriously and that steps are implemented to ensure it does not happen to another family's pet.
